tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The HPE ProLiant Compute DL384 Gen12 Server is a high-performance 2U rack server designed for demanding AI, high-performance computing, large-scale simulation, engineering, and memory-intensive workloads. It is built around the NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip platform and supports configurations with single or dual GH200 superchips for accelerated computing.


The DL384 Gen12 combines powerful Arm-based CPU processing with high-bandwidth GPU acceleration and large unified memory capacity. A dual GH200 NVL2 configuration can provide up to 1.2TB of LPDDR5X unified memory and high-bandwidth connectivity through NVIDIA NVLink technology, making the platform suitable for large language model inference, AI workloads, and demanding HPC applications.


With PCIe Gen5 expansion, EDSFF NVMe storage options, OCP 3.0 connectivity, NVIDIA networking support, and HPE iLO management, the HPE ProLiant Compute DL384 Gen12 is designed for modern data center environments requiring high-performance accelerated computing.


Key Features


  • HPE ProLiant Compute DL384 Gen12 2U Rack Server
  • Designed for AI and high-performance computing workloads
  • Supports NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip
  • Supports single or dual GH200 configurations
  • Dual GH200 NVL2 configuration available
  • Up to 1.2TB unified LPDDR5X memory in dual GH200 NVL2 configuration
  • NVIDIA HBM3e high-bandwidth memory
  • PCIe Gen5 expansion capabilities
  • OCP 3.0 networking options
  • Supports EDSFF NVMe Gen5 drives
  • Supports high-speed NVIDIA InfiniBand and Ethernet adapters
  • HPE iLO management
  • HPE Silicon Root of Trust security architecture
  • 2U standard 19-inch rack form factor
  • Suitable for AI inference, LLM workloads and HPC applications
